facts.fact: Lei n.º 9/26 of 28 September 2026, in force on publication, creates a National Cybersecurity System comprising the Conselho Nacional de Cibersegurança, the Centro Nacional de Cibersegurança and a national CSIRT network; CERT.ao is the Centre's operational arm (PTI, 2 October 2026).

Lei n.º 9/26 requires operators of critical infrastructure, essential services, electronic communications, data centres, cloud and digital services to register with the Centre within 180 days and notify significant incidents to CERT.ao, with deadlines to be set by separate instrument.

note: Law text itself not held; facts rest on the PTI report. No incident handled or figures stated.
